units.title: The Need for Values
units.topics: Students will learn about the need for values as part of their holistic development to become successful in their many roles - as ambitious students, reliable employees, caring family members, and considerate citizens.

units.title: Remaking Yourself: Restructuring Yourself
units.topics: Students learn how self-improvement enables them to secure a bright future for themselves. They will learn 6 powerful thought-processes that can develop their intellectual, physical, emotional, and spiritual quotients.

units.title: Remaking Yourself: Power of Habit
units.topics: Students will undergo a study of how habits work, the habits of successful professionals, and the practical techniques that can be used to develop good habits in their life.

units.title: Learning from Legends: Tendulkar & Tata
units.topics: Students will learn from the inspirational lives of India's two legends, Sachin Tendulkar and Ratan Tata. They will implement these lessons through relatable case studies.

units.title: From House to Home: Listening & Understanding
units.topics: Active listening is an essential part of academic progress and communications. Students will learn to listen with their eyes, ears, mind, and heart.

units.title: Facing Failures: Welcoming Challenges
units.topics: This lecture enables students to revisit the way in which they approach challenges. Through the study of successful figures such as Disney, Lincoln and Bachchan, students will learn to face difficulties through a positive perspective.

units.title: Facing Failures: Significance of Failures
units.topics: Failure is a student’s daily source of fear, negativity, and depression. Students will be given the constructive skills to understand failure as formative learning experiences.

units.title: My India My Pride: Glorious Past - Part 1
units.topics: India’s ancient Rishis, scholars, and intellectuals have made tremendous contributions to the world, they developed an advanced, sophisticated culture and civilization which began thousands of years ago. Students will learn the importance of studying India’s glorious past so that they could develop a strong passion and pride for our nation.

units.title: My India My Pride: Glorious Past - Part 2
units.topics: Our ancient concepts can be used to seek revolutionary ideas and to generate inspiration. Students will develop a deeper interest in India’s Glorious Past – by appreciating the need to read about it, research it, write about it, and share it.

units.title: Learning from Legends: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam
units.topics: Dr Kalam’s inspirational life displayed legendary qualities which apply to students (1) Dare to Dream (2) Work Hard (3) Get Good Guidance (4) Humility (5) Use Your Talents for the Benefit of Others

units.title: Soft Skills: Networking & Leadership
units.topics: Students are taught the means of building a professional network and developing a leadership attitude.

units.title: Soft Skills: Project Management
units.topics: Students will learn the secrets of project management through the Akshardham case study. They will then practice these skills through an activity relevant to student life.

units.title: Remaking Yourself: Handling Social Media
units.topics: Students will learn how social media can become addictive and they will imbibe simple methods to take back control.

units.title: Facing Failures: Power of Faith
units.topics: Students will learn about the power and necessity of faith in our daily lives.

units.title: From House to Home: Bonding the Family
units.topics: Students will understand the importance of strong family relationships. They will learn how to overcome the generation gap and connect with their family more.

units.title: Selfless Service: Seva
units.topics: Students will learn that performing seva is beneficial to one’s health, wellbeing, and happiness. It also benefits and inspires others.
